main_text.p: dius in urbibus ejus, Hos.11.6. estq[?] acutitonum propter Vau hippuch. Infin. חוֹל תְּחוֹל Dolendo dolebit, Ezech.30.16. לְחוֹל Vide in חלל. Imperat. חוּלִי וְגוֹחִי Parturi & edi-to partum, Mich.4.10. A' facie Domini חוּלִי הָאָרֶץ In-tremisce terra, Psal.114.7. Futur. עַל רֹאשׁ Super caput impiorum יָחוֹל permanebit, Jerem.23.19. וַתְּחֵל Et indo-lescet, Jerem.51.29. יְחוֹלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ Maneant super caput, 2.Sam.3.29. Pih. חוֹלֵל Genuit, Peperit, Emixa est, Pa-rere fecit: Metaphoricè, Formavit, & Deo tribuitur, cujus partus sunt res creatæ omnes: Dolere fecit, Dolo-re affecit: Item, Solicitè exspectavit; & ita construi-tur cum Dativo: Præter. חוֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת Enitítur cerva, id est, cerva quæque, Job.39.4. חוֹלְלוּ יָדוֹ Formavit manus ejus, Job.26.13. Partic. רַב מְחוֹלֵל־כֹּל Magister formatomnia, Proverb.26.10. variant Hebrei: מְחוֹלֲלֶךָ Forma-toris tui, Deut.32.18. Fœmin. מְחוֹלֶלֶת הַנִּין Dolore af-ficiens balanam, Jesa.51.9. Futur. תְּחוֹל נְשַׁם Partu-rit vel gignit pluviam, Proverbior.25.23. Sic Chaldæus, בְּטַנָּא Concipit, Græci ἐξεγείρει Suscitat. Quidam red-dunt, Avertit, Fugat, respicientes ad significatum vocis derivata חִלִּילוּ [?] (de qua in חלל, cujus meminit Aben Esra) הַתְּחוֹלֵל אָרֶץ Formasses terram, Psal.90.2. וַתְּחוֹלֵל לוֹ Et exspecta eum, Job.35.14. Pyh. Præterit. חוֹלֵלְתָּה For-matus es, Job.15.7. Particip. מְחוֹלָל מִפִּשְׁעֵינוּ Dolore assi-citur propter defectiones nostras, Jesa.35.5. Futur. יְחוֹלֲלוּ Reformabuntur, Job.26.5. Hiph. Imperat. חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו Contremiscite à conspectu ejus, Psal.69.9. ubi deficit ה cha-racteristicum, cui simile fuit in דוג: Futurum, יְחִיל מִדְבָּר Dolore assicit desertum; id est; deserti seras, Psalm.29. v.8. vel, Parturire facit, ut sequitur versu sequenti: לִבִּי יְחִיל Animus meus dolet intra me, Psalm.55.5. לֹא יְחִיל טוּבוֹ Non permanet bonum ejus, Job.20.21. page.notes: Hebrew and Greek copied from the scan; several Hebrew forms (marked [?]) are blurred and their vowel points and letters are uncertain. The Greek word after "Græci" and the reference "Psal.90.2" line are doubtful. The running heads are Hebrew letters, read as חב (left) and חו (right). A dark blot at the left margin beside the line "Vide in" is not text. Italic marking is approximate, since the scan is soft. The line "Formavit," and the reference "Hos.11.6." are as printed.
